role: IT Development Program (3 Months - Path to Hire)
paragraphs: I'm applying for the IT Development Program in El Segundo. A three-month path to hire alongside experienced systems administrators, supporting dual-use space work, is the kind of fast, hands-on start I'm looking for. I finished my B.S. in Computer Science at UC Irvine in June 2026, specializing in Networked Systems. I'm local to Orange County and a U.S. citizen.

My networking coursework covered IP addressing, DNS and TLS, and in labs I used Wireshark to troubleshoot and analyze traffic. I've also run a live system end to end. I built and operate CommunicAI, an AI-powered iOS app on the App Store running on Gemini Flash and Google Cloud, and I handle its user accounts and security: sign-in with Apple, Google and verified email, role-based access rules tested with 36 adversarial unit tests, and full account deletion. Keeping it running has meant plenty of troubleshooting and learning new tools quickly.

I know this isn't a 40-hour-a-week role, and that suits me. As captain of UC Irvine's NCAA Division I track and field team, I'm used to long days, staying calm under pressure and following through. I'm also studying for the CompTIA Security+ exam in January.
I'd welcome the chance to earn a full-time spot on your team and I'm ready to start when the program does.
